name: io.browsa/browsa
description: Cloud browsers for AI agents, and captcha solving for a browser of your own.

environmentVariables.name: BROWSA_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Browsa API key from https://app.browsa.io/dashboard/keys. detect_captcha runs without it.

environmentVariables.name: BROWSA_MCP_TOOLS
environmentVariables.description: Optional tool groups, e.g. tasks,robots or captcha_page; all for every group; captcha_page,-core for only the captcha tools.

environmentVariables.name: BROWSA_CAPTCHA_MAX_CREDITS
environmentVariables.description: Optional. The most credits one session may spend on captcha solves.

environmentVariables.name: BROWSA_CAPTCHA_RATE_PER_MINUTE
environmentVariables.description: Optional. The most captcha solves started in any 60 seconds.

environmentVariables.name: BROWSA_CAPTCHA_CONCURRENCY
environmentVariables.description: Optional. The most captcha solves running at once.

environmentVariables.name: BROWSA_LLM_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Optional. Your own LLM provider key for the tasks group. Without it, tasks run on a saved key or a Browsa hosted tier.
